description: Iowa’s earned income tax credit is a refundable state credit tied to the federal EITC. Claim it on the Iowa income-tax return.
introduction: Iowa’s earned income tax credit is a refundable state credit tied to the federal EITC. Claim it on the Iowa income-tax return.

sections.who: You must qualify for the federal EITC. Check the federal rules for the tax year you are filing rather than using a current-year estimate for an older return.
sections.get: For tax year 2025, the state credit is 15% of the federal EITC. Part-year residents and nonresidents adjust it using the Iowa income percentage on IA 126.
sections.docs: Keep the federal return and EITC calculation, wage records, and any IA 126 used to allocate Iowa income. Keep dependent and filing-status records with the return.
sections.apply:
1. Calculate federal EITC first. Use Iowa’s instructions for the same tax year.

  2. For a 2025 return, calculate the Iowa credit and enter it on line 25. Follow the special instructions if filing only to receive EITC under the low-income exemption.
sections.after: Save both returns and supporting calculations. If Revenue asks for records, use the channel and deadline in its notice.
